name: computer-control
description: Control macOS desktop apps through the Accessibility tree: read UI as text, click, type, press keys, clipboard, screenshots

nodes.title: List running apps
nodes.description: List running apps that have a Dock icon, with which one is frontmost and whether COMPUTER_CONTROL_ALLOWED_APPS allows it. data.text is a readable summary.

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Open app
nodes.description: Launch an app (or bring it to the front if it is already running), like `open -a` (or `open -b` for a bundle id such as net.whatsapp.WhatsApp).

app.description: App name or bundle id as shown by list_apps, e.g. "Finder" or "net.whatsapp.WhatsApp" (must be in COMPUTER_CONTROL_ALLOWED_APPS)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Focus app
nodes.description: Bring a running app to the front so it receives keyboard input.

app.description: App name or bundle id as shown by list_apps, e.g. "Finder" or "net.whatsapp.WhatsApp" (must be in COMPUTER_CONTROL_ALLOWED_APPS)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Quit app
nodes.description: Ask a running app to quit, like Cmd+Q (it may still ask to save documents). Workflow node only, never an agent tool.

app.description: App name or bundle id as shown by list_apps, e.g. "Finder" or "net.whatsapp.WhatsApp" (must be in COMPUTER_CONTROL_ALLOWED_APPS)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: List windows
nodes.description: List an app's windows (ref w1 = frontmost) with title, position and size. data.text is a readable summary.

app.description: App name or bundle id as shown by list_apps, e.g. "Finder" or "net.whatsapp.WhatsApp" (must be in COMPUTER_CONTROL_ALLOWED_APPS)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Read app UI
nodes.description: Read a window's Accessibility tree as elements {ref, role, title, value, description, enabled, focused, position, size}. data.text is a compact indented outline; pass the refs exactly as shown (e.g. w1/3/2#0a1b2c3) to click_element, set_value and focus_element. A ref fails with not_found once that element changed: read_ui again. Long output is cut (data.output_truncated).

app.description: App name or bundle id as shown by list_apps, e.g. "Finder" or "net.whatsapp.WhatsApp" (must be in COMPUTER_CONTROL_ALLOWED_APPS)

root_ref.description: Read only the sub-tree under this ref (e.g. "w1/3#0a1b2c3") instead of the whole window

max_depth.description: Levels below the root to read

text_only.description: Only return elements that have a title, value, description or placeholder

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Find UI elements
nodes.description: Find elements in a window by role (e.g. "button", "AXTextField") and/or text contained in their title, value, description or placeholder (case-insensitive).

app.description: App name or bundle id as shown by list_apps, e.g. "Finder" or "net.whatsapp.WhatsApp" (must be in COMPUTER_CONTROL_ALLOWED_APPS)

root_ref.description: Read only the sub-tree under this ref (e.g. "w1/3#0a1b2c3") instead of the whole window

role.description: Accessibility role, with or without the AX prefix, e.g. "button"

exact.description: Require the whole text to match instead of contains

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Click element
nodes.description: Press an element by ref (AXPress). If it has no press action, click its centre with the mouse (brings the app to the front); the click is refused when the centre is outside the element's window or another app's window covers it.

app.description: App name or bundle id as shown by list_apps, e.g. "Finder" or "net.whatsapp.WhatsApp" (must be in COMPUTER_CONTROL_ALLOWED_APPS)

ref.description: Element ref exactly as read_ui or find_elements returned it, e.g. "w1/3/2#0a1b2c3" (the #fingerprint makes a changed UI fail instead of acting on another element)

fallback_click.description: Click the element's centre when AXPress is not supported

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Set element value
nodes.description: Set the text of a text field or text area by ref (AXValue), without typing. Some apps ignore values set this way; then use focus_element + type_text.

app.description: App name or bundle id as shown by list_apps, e.g. "Finder" or "net.whatsapp.WhatsApp" (must be in COMPUTER_CONTROL_ALLOWED_APPS)

ref.description: Element ref exactly as read_ui or find_elements returned it, e.g. "w1/3/2#0a1b2c3" (the #fingerprint makes a changed UI fail instead of acting on another element)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Focus element
nodes.description: Bring the app to the front and move keyboard focus to an element by ref, e.g. before type_text.

app.description: App name or bundle id as shown by list_apps, e.g. "Finder" or "net.whatsapp.WhatsApp" (must be in COMPUTER_CONTROL_ALLOWED_APPS)

ref.description: Element ref exactly as read_ui or find_elements returned it, e.g. "w1/3/2#0a1b2c3" (the #fingerprint makes a changed UI fail instead of acting on another element)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Type text
nodes.description: Bring an app to the front and type text into its focused element. method keystroke (default, at most 1000 characters) types key by key in chunks, and "\n" presses Return; insert puts the text into the focused text field through Accessibility (no keys, no clipboard; "\n" is a line break) and checks it arrived; paste uses the clipboard, checks the text arrived, then restores the clipboard. Typing stops if another app takes focus.

app.description: App name or bundle id as shown by list_apps, e.g. "Finder" or "net.whatsapp.WhatsApp" (must be in COMPUTER_CONTROL_ALLOWED_APPS)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Press keys
nodes.description: Bring an app to the front and press key combos, e.g. "cmd+f", "enter", "cmd+shift+n" or a space-separated sequence "cmd+a delete". Modifiers: cmd, shift, ctrl, opt. Keys: letters, digits, punctuation, enter, tab, space, delete, escape, arrows (up/down/left/right), home, end, pageup, pagedown, f1-f12. System-wide shortcuts (cmd+tab, cmd+space, ctrl+arrows, cmd+q, cmd+h, cmd+m, screenshots, lock screen, force quit) are refused.

app.description: App name or bundle id as shown by list_apps, e.g. "Finder" or "net.whatsapp.WhatsApp" (must be in COMPUTER_CONTROL_ALLOWED_APPS)

keys.description: Key combos separated by spaces, e.g. "cmd+f"

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Click at point
nodes.description: Bring an app to the front and click at screen coordinates (points, as in read_ui positions). The point must be inside one of that app's windows and not covered by another app's window.

app.description: App name or bundle id as shown by list_apps, e.g. "Finder" or "net.whatsapp.WhatsApp" (must be in COMPUTER_CONTROL_ALLOWED_APPS)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Get clipboard
nodes.description: Read the clipboard as plain text (null when it holds no text). Needs COMPUTER_CONTROL_ALLOW_CLIPBOARD_READ=1, because the clipboard may hold anything copied in any app.

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Set clipboard
nodes.description: Replace the clipboard with plain text.

text.description: Text to put on the clipboard

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Take screenshot
nodes.description: Save a PNG screenshot of one app window (when `app` is given; only that window, by window id) or of the main display (needs COMPUTER_CONTROL_ALLOW_FULL_SCREENSHOT=1) to COMPUTER_CONTROL_SCREENSHOT_DIR (default: a temp folder). Returns the file path; agents cannot see the image, use read_ui to read the UI.

app.description: Capture only this app's window (optional)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Send WhatsApp Desktop message
nodes.description: Workflow node only: send a message in the WhatsApp for Mac app to an existing chat, by its exact name. Opens search, requires exactly one chat-list match, checks the conversation header and the empty message box, inserts the message and presses Return. Takes keyboard focus for a few seconds. Needs WhatsApp (or net.whatsapp.WhatsApp) in COMPUTER_CONTROL_ALLOWED_APPS. Never retried automatically.

chat.description: Exact chat or contact name as shown in WhatsApp

text.description: Message text; "\n" becomes a line break

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
